Name: Mobile Phone NSFW Themes
Author: MortaliB
Description:
To use this mod you will need a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21017]Mobile Phone[/url]

This mod adds 85 new themes to the phone, each one with 2 images.

The art in this mod is created by [url=https://twitter.com/Milk64Art]Milk64[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Eduuux_Art]Eduuux[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Lunchbox_3D]Lunchbox[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/r34seeker]r34seeker[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/5_ish]5-ish

[/url]There is an old version in the files to work with Mobile Phone instead of Mobile Phone Continued
